name: rolling-memory
description: Rolling Memory 记忆系统：基于 Rolling Autonoetic Memory Engine（洛灵自知记忆引擎 · 100% 向量无关与 LLM 无关）的 Coding Agent 记忆插件，自包含单一技能（rolling-memory）、MCP 单工具（recall · 回忆即记忆）、轻量提示 Hook（UserPromptSubmit）及自动单路去重。
description_en: Rolling Memory: a 100% Vector-Free & LLM-Free local memory plugin (Rolling Autonoetic Memory Engine) with a single `recall` MCP tool, a self-contained skill, a lightweight UserPromptSubmit hook, and automatic single-path deduplication.
